hero.heading: Small world.
hero.body: Collect little wonders. Find your people. Leave a little room for play.

chapters.label: A softer place to land
chapters.heading: Come as you are.
chapters.body: A tiny village, a winding path, and a whole lot of squishy possibility. Take your first little step.

chapters.label: Little things. Lovely discoveries.
chapters.heading:
Find your kind
of squishy.
chapters.body: Open a box, meet a new favorite, and grow a collection that feels like you. Every squeeze has a little spring in it.

chapters.label: Better with a little company
chapters.heading:
Your happy place,
shared.
chapters.body: Meet in a public room or send a private invite. Wander together, say hello, and make a little space for each other.

features.title: Soft by nature.
features.body: Plush characters, springy steps, and a satisfying little squish. Hold Space, or use the Squish me button.

features.title: A world to wander.
features.body: Follow the paths through the village, visit the shops, and explore the gardens, woods, and shore.

features.title: A room for your people.
features.body: Join a public world or create an invite-only room. Your friends can see your avatar move and squish in real time.

closing.eyebrow: There is a little wonder waiting for you
closing.heading:
Make yourself
a little happier.
closing.body: Your next cozy adventure is one small click away.

faq.question: Do I need to download anything?
faq.answer: No app installation is needed. Open the game in a browser and choose a public room, a friends room, or a solo adventure.

faq.question: Can I play with friends?
faq.answer: Yes. Create a friends room and share its invite link or room code. Live movement, avatars, squishing, and room chat are shared.

faq.question: How is my progress saved?
faq.answer: Your collection and coins are saved in this browser. Keep a copy of your save code to move progress to another device. Accounts and cloud saves are not available yet.

faq.question: What can I do in the kingdom?
faq.answer: Collect squishies, explore the 3D world, visit NPC traders, follow quests, and play tower and battle minigames. Those minigames use their existing views; collections and progression run locally.
